fact: Radio Yei reports that consumer protection rules have taken effect in South Sudan under the amended Electronic Money Regulation, covering banks and non-bank e-money issuers, including availability, user notice of disruptions and record keeping.

The Bank of South Sudan issued a notice covering consumer protection for banks, microfinance institutions and digital financial service providers, requiring clear fee and loan disclosure, complaint contacts and no harassment or fraudulent deductions.
